cardOverview.overviewText: An Elite+ card from Yes Bank delivering luxury lifestyle benefits, unlimited lounge access, milestone rewards, and concierge support for affluent professionals.

items.child: 25% off on booking movie tickets via BookMyShow.

benefitRows.name: BookMyShow
benefitRows.description: 25% off on booking movie tickets via BookMyShow.
benefitRows.howToAvail: To avail this offer, visit the BookMyShow website or app.|Select your movie, date, time, and seats.|Proceed to payment and find the offers/discounts section.|Select the applicable bank discount offer and enter your card details.|Complete the payment to get the Offer.

benefitRows.name: Golf
benefitRows.offer: one complimentary golf lesson every calendar month at select golf courses in India.|Also, cardholders can avail green fee waiver at 4 golf courses in India.
benefitRows.howToAvail: Access the designated golf booking portal using the email ID registered with your credit card. Choose your preferred golf course, date, and time, and complete the booking. You’ll receive a confirmation via email, take this with you when you play. Note that additional costs like caddy fees and carts are usually not covered and must be paid at the course.
